subject: Predictive scaling pilot incident (Hexagon) — follow-up + hotfix PR 48321
body:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 23, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Predictive scaling pilot incident (Hexagon) — follow-up + hotfix PR 48321

Team — quick follow-up from last night’s pilot incident w/ Hexagon.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Predictive signal provider returned null for a single interval during the ramp window.
- Autoscaler treated that as “0 desired” in the predictive path and attempted to scale down aggressively (bounded by min, but still caused churn/latency jitter).
- We disabled predictive mode for the deployment as mitigation.

Tracking:
- Customer-facing ticket: SUP-28479 (oscillation / jitter)
- Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/48321 (prevent scale-to-zero when predictor returns null; add guard + test)

Proposed owners + deadlines:
1) Hotfix merge + deploy to pilot region (us-east-1) — Vanessa (today EOD)
2) Add alert for “prediction null/stale” + dashboard annotation — Neha to advise on thresholding (by tomorrow noon)
3) Pilot comms + status update to customer (what changed / when re-enable) — Lauren (today by 2pm PT)
4) Exec visibility: send short note for go/no-go risk register — Vanessa (today after deploy)

Open question: do we want to auto-fallback to purely reactive scaling for N minutes when predictor is null/stale, vs treating it as a no-op? PR 48321 is the minimal guard; we can follow up with the full fallback behavior behind the feature flag.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Fleet Autoscaling Lead
Redwood Inference


From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 23, 2025 at 9:28 AM PT
Subject: Re: Predictive scaling pilot incident (Hexagon) — follow-up + hotfix PR 48321

Thanks. I’ll send comms to Hexagon + Liam after we have a deploy timestamp.

For customer wording: can we say “predictive mode disabled temporarily; reactive autoscaling unchanged” and “guard added to ignore invalid predictions”? Want to be careful about implying the system would ever scale to 0.

Also please confirm whether min bound was honored throughout (I want that explicitly called out).

— Lauren


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 23, 2025 at 9:41 AM PT
Subject: Re: Predictive scaling pilot incident (Hexagon) — follow-up + hotfix PR 48321

Yes on wording.

Confirmations:
- Min bound was honored; no scale-down below min.
- The issue was rapid down/up adjustments around min during the ramp window (churn), which is what they observed as latency jitter.

You can say:
- “We observed an invalid forecast interval; we’ve added a safeguard to ignore invalid/stale forecasts and fall back to normal scaling behavior.”
- “Predictive mode is disabled for your deployment until the safeguard is deployed and we validate stability.”

I’ll reply again once PR is merged + roll is kicked off.


From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 23, 2025 at 10:06 AM PT
Subject: Re: Predictive scaling pilot incident (Hexagon) — follow-up + hotfix PR 48321

On alerts: recommend we treat “null prediction” and “stale prediction” as distinct signals.

Suggestion (pilot-only to start):
- Page (or at least high-urgency alert) if null/stale persists > 2 consecutive intervals AND deployment is in ramp window (queue depth rising).
- Non-paging alert if null/stale appears intermittently but reactive signals are stable.

I’m fine with a conservative alert now + tune down later. Also recommend we log the predictor response status as an explicit reason field in the scaling decision audit event.


From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 23, 2025 at 10:22 AM PT
Subject: Re: Predictive scaling pilot incident (Hexagon) — follow-up + hotfix PR 48321

Approved to fast-track the hotfix to pilot, but we need two things before re-enabling predictive mode for any customer:

1) Clear fallback semantics documented (null/stale => reactive only for a defined window; bounds still enforced)
2) Pilot gating checklist updated (alerts + runbook section for predictor health)

Vanessa — please send a short update after deploy (what changed, where rolled, and whether we’re re-enabling Hexagon this week).


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jul 23, 2025 at 1:48 PM PT
Subject: Re: Predictive scaling pilot incident (Hexagon) — follow-up + hotfix PR 48321

Update:
- PR 48321 merged.
- Deploy kicked off to pilot autoscaler in us-east-1 at ~1:10pm PT; ETA completion ~2:30pm PT.

What changed (one-liner):
- If predictor returns null, autoscaler will not treat it as a desired capacity signal; it will continue with reactive evaluation and keep existing anti-oscillation guardrails.

Next steps:
- Lauren: you can tell Hexagon the safeguard is deploying today; we’ll keep predictive mode disabled through tomorrow’s ramp and then propose a monitored re-enable.
- Neha: if you can drop proposed thresholds into the alert ticket notes, we’ll implement pilot-only first.

I’ll send a final note after we confirm stability in the post-deploy canary window.

—
Vanessa
